title: Worker Algorithmic Decision Appeal Log
description: An observable log of automated decisions materially affecting a platform worker (account restrictions, deactivations, scoring penalties), whether the worker was informed of the basis, and the outcome of any appeal.
evidence_description: A record of every automated decision materially affecting a platform worker, the disclosed basis given to the worker, whether the worker appealed, and the human reviewer's resolution — including cases where the reviewer reversed the automated outcome, which is the observable signal that review is genuine.
collection_method: Automatically logged at decision time, with appeal outcomes recorded by the human reviewer.
artifact_format: Structured export (CSV/JSON) of decision, disclosure, and appeal records.

citations.title: Historic digital rights win for WIE and the ADCU over Uber and Ola at Amsterdam Court of Appeal
